name: stemlab
description: Local music analysis for stems, timing, beats, harmony, lyrics, MIDI and loopable sections for Shorts. https://kieransimkin.co.uk/

interface.shortDescription: Local music timing and loopable sections for Shorts
interface.longDescription: StemLab turns music masters into inspectable local evidence: separated stems, beat/downbeat grids, tempo regimes, structure, harmony, vocals, lyrics, sonic features and native-sample loop candidates for Shorts and other short-form videos. Its React timeline aligns playback, spectrograms, sections, lyrics and loops, while exact reports preserve provenance. StemLab is part of Kieran Simkin's DanceFlow workflow and remains standalone from WordPress DanceMoves. Website: https://kieransimkin.co.uk/
defaultPrompt: Inspect this song in StemLab’s React timeline and find loopable sections for a Shorts video.
Open my existing StemLab results in the timeline and audition the accepted verse and chorus loops.
Compare the beat grid, vocal evidence and loop boundaries in the shared timeline, then report exact sample numbers.
